selector.champion: Lightning-induced retinopathy with delayed-onset cystoid macular abnormalities
selector.rationale: The patient's symptoms and OCT findings, including intraretinal cystoid changes and subfoveal ellipsoid zone disruption, are consistent with lightning-induced retinopathy with delayed-onset cystoid macular abnormalities.

rejected.label: Photoreceptor damage
rejected.why: While photoreceptor damage is a possible consequence of the injury, the specific diagnosis of lightning-induced retinopathy better explains the patient's symptoms and findings.

rejected.label: Lightning-induced cataract
rejected.why: Although a cataract developed, it is not the primary diagnosis that explains the patient's initial symptoms of decreased vision.

rejected.label: Electrical injury to the eye
rejected.why: This is a broader category that encompasses the champion diagnosis, but is less specific.

rejected.label: Cystoid macular edema
rejected.why: This is a symptom rather than a specific diagnosis, and is part of the presentation of the champion diagnosis.

rejected.label: Traumatic maculopathy
rejected.why: While traumatic maculopathy is a possible diagnosis, the specific findings and history of lightning strike make lightning-induced retinopathy a more specific and appropriate diagnosis.
